known_ocr_limitations.location_name: Real Tesseract on this scan (confirmed 2026-09-09, not assumed) swallows unrelated column-2 boilerplate between 'Location:' and the parser's boundary keyword, returning 'LOVES COUNTRY STORE TRAILER AXLE 18840 LB 145 EXIT 95 PUBLIC WEIGHER WILLIS' instead of just the true location text - the same two-column-layout jumbling limitation already documented for CatScale-GooseOnly.jpg in golden_fields.json. src/hdttools/scale_ticket_ocr.py's own module docstring already scopes location_name as best-effort.

_note: A real CAT Scale full-rig ticket (Tractor GOOSE / Trailer ADDIE, Wandering Trails Inc, RV Brinkley G4170), Loves Country Store I-45 Exit 95, Willis TX, dated 8-16-26. Same real rig as the legacy ExampleDocs/CatScale-Ticket.jpg and CatScale-GooseOnly.jpg entries in golden_fields.json, but a distinct real weighing event (different date/location/weights than either), so it needed its own vehicle entry rather than joining theirs - a scale-ticket's golden truth is per-weighing-event, not a fixed physical plate like a truck/trailer tag. All fields except location_name confirmed exact via real Tesseract, 2026-09-09.
